recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if OO opens a new issue to change Task.location cardinality or to add separate transport modeling guidance; FHIR-28398 itself is already correctly reflected in current Task source.
issue_request: FHIR-28398 asked to allow multiple locations on Task.location. It was Published with resolution Not Persuasive with Modification: keep Task.location as the primary single location and add usage notes saying it should only be used when the task occurs primarily within one Location, with source, destination, or other locations represented on the basedOn request or as distinct Task.input values.
initial_application: Jira records the application commit as 4c753f175be3e7fba21736ad38a0c3bcf3b774c6, which added the requested Task.location comment to source/task/structuredefinition-Task.xml. The current source retains that comment and retains max 1 for Task.location.
additional_context: Task is an active resource in source/fhir.ini and is assigned to OO. Later Task.location issue FHIR-47391 changed only the requirements text and preserved the FHIR-28398 comment. OO minutes from 2022-08-04 record acceptance of FHIR-28398 by a 10-0-4 vote, and earlier FHIR-I workflow minutes record transfer to OO with recommendation. Zulip searches for Task location and transport terms did not reveal a conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative Task source already implements the approved resolution: Task.location remains the single principal physical location and its comment directs other locations to basedOn or Task.input.
